## Library Loading

```{r}
#| message: false
library("here")
library("tidyverse")
```

## Data Folder

```{r}
data_dir <- here("data")
raw_data_dir <- here("data/_raw")

if (!dir.exists(data_dir)) {
  dir.create(data_dir)
}

if (!dir.exists(raw_data_dir)) {
  dir.create(raw_data_dir)
}
```

## Donor Metadata

#### (Roke)

```{r}
#| message: false

metadata_file = str_c(raw_data_dir, "/donor_metadata.csv")

if (!file.exists(metadata_file)){
  url <- "https://aging.brain-map.org/api/v2/data/query.csv?criteria=model::ApiTbiDonorDetail,rma::options[num_rows$eqall]"
  
  donor_metadata <- read_csv(url)
  
  write_csv(x = donor_metadata,
            file = metadata_file)
}
```

## Protein Data

#### (Pilar)

```{r}
#| message: false

prot_file = str_c(raw_data_dir, "/prot_data.csv")

if (!file.exists(prot_file)){
  prot_data <- read_csv("https://aging.brain-map.org/api/v2/data/query.csv?criteria=model::ApiTbiDonorMetric,rma::options[num_rows$eqall]")
  
  write_csv(x = prot_data,
            file = prot_file)
}
```

## RNA-Seq Data

#### (Teo)

```{r}
#| message: false
#| echo: false

url <- "https://aging.brain-map.org/api/v2/well_known_file_download/502999992"

rnaseq.zip <- str_c(raw_data_dir, "/rnaseq.zip")
unnecessary_file <- map_chr(.x = c("fpkm_table_unnormalized.csv",
                                   "README.txt"),
                            ~ str_c(raw_data_dir, "/", .x)
                            )
initial_rnaseq_file <- str_c(raw_data_dir, "/fpkm_table_normalized.csv")
final_rnaseq_file <- str_c(rnaseq_file, ".gz")


options(timeout=300) # default is 120 (too little to manage)
if (!file.exists(final_rnaseq_file)){
  download.file(url, destfile = rnaseq.zip, mode = "wb")
  unzip(rnaseq.zip, exdir = raw_data_dir)
  
  fpkm_normalized <- read_csv(rnaseq_file)
  write_csv(x = fpkm_normalized, 
            file = final_rnaseq_file)
  # gzip the file to occupy less space
  
  file.remove(c(rnaseq.zip, 
                unnecessary_file, 
                initial_rnaseq_file)
              )
  # removing all the unnecessary files
}
```
